corrections.old_claim: Eq.(6.9) and Eq.(B.13) have conflicting powers of z_star.
corrections.replacement: No conflict: Appendix B explicitly defines Hcal=aH (PDF p.31). B.13 uses Hcal, Eq.(6.9) uses cosmic H. Thus sigma≈z_star/(10^4 Hcal_star)=z_star(1+z_star)/(10^4 H_star)≈z_star^2/(10^4 H_star) at z_star>>1. Preserve the approximation and distinguish conformal time from cosmic time.
checked_locators: Appendix B definition following Eq.(B.1), PDF p.31

corrections.old_claim: 70 seeds with chi2<1060 and mean Om 0.27±0.03.
corrections.replacement: The PDF prints 1060; this conflicts with best-fit 1481.9 and Fig. 4. Retain the printed threshold as unresolved, and do not use its 70-seed statistic for a derived test or guess 1600.
corrections.action: Keep source issue, no silent repair.

corrections.old_claim: Sec.7 percentages differ from Sec.4.1 counts.
corrections.replacement: Sec.4.1 states 55/90000 in [1481,1490] and 16/90000 better than LambdaCDM. Arithmetic fractions are about 0.0611% and 0.0178%. Sec.7 says about 0.14% similar and 0.015% better. The similar-fit threshold is not restated there, so this is an unreconciled summary, not proof the same precisely defined subset was miscounted. Use exact Sec.4.1 counts with finite-sample conditioning; do not turn summary percentages into model probabilities.
corrections.action: Narrow the original caveat; exclude summary percentages from quantitative acceptance.

corrections.old_claim: Appendix A combines marginalized likelihoods consistently with main-text Bayesian model averaging.
corrections.replacement: Main text Eqs.(4.3)-(4.4) weights normalized fixed-seed posteriors by P(s|D) proportional to marginal likelihood times seed prior; harmonic-mean likelihood estimates are stated. Appendix A Method 3 Eq.(A.6) instead says average normalized posteriors equally. Those operations differ unless seed evidences are equal. Actual implementation is unknown; preserve source-reported Eq.(4.5) as a conditional reported result, not independently verified model marginalization.
checked_locators: Appendix A Method 3 Eqs.(A.5)-(A.6), PDF p.30
corrections.action: Add visible source methodology caveat; exact source code and weighting required before evidence reuse.

corrections.old_claim: No arXiv ID is printed in reference[101].
corrections.replacement: Reference[101] explicitly prints astro-ph/9506072. Set printed_arxiv_base_id to astro-ph/9506072, version null; do not infer the registered v1 was the cited version.

corrections.old_claim: Eq.(29) defines deltaLambda as energy-density terms plus one-half friction integral, and Eq.(33) follows by differentiation.
corrections.replacement: The transcription is faithful, but the chain is inconsistent: Eq.(28) adds deltaLambda/(8piG) to an energy-density Hamiltonian, Eq.(31) adds deltaLambda to geometric Lambda, yet Eq.(29) RHS has density units. Its derivative also has coefficient beta_bar m_p/2 rather than the beta_bar m_p in Eq.(33). Eq.(27) and scalar continuity support the coefficient/sign in Eq.(33); this is a diagnostic, not authority to rewrite Eq.(29). Keep the deterministic system conditional and the Hamiltonian normalization blocked.
corrections.action: Add visible printed-source caveat; do not relabel it as a Luna transcription error.

corrections.old_claim: Eq.(A9) equilibrium rho=T_d^4 is inconsistent with printed averages; rho=T_d^4/2 is reader algebra.
corrections.replacement: Confirmed literally from displayed averages and Eq.(33): 0=beta_bar m_p(2rho-T_d^4)/(3Lambda t^2). This identifies the printed factor mismatch; rho=T_d^4/2 is not adopted as the physically repaired equilibrium. White-noise endpoint normalization, finite-cutoff limit and bath mode-sum measure are unspecified. Appendix A does calculate <xi phi_dot>, so omission of that correlation is not an objection. A nonzero constant equilibrium density would additionally require an expanding-background continuity check; the homogeneous scalar has p=rho, not radiation.
checked_locators: PDF p.5 Eq.(30), p.6 footnote 8 and Eq.(35)
corrections.action: Retain narrow source arithmetic issue separately from Eq.(29); block quantitative Eq.(A10) reuse.
